sloka: सा राघवम् उपासीनम् असुख आर्ता सुख उचिता ।उवाच पुरुष व्याघ्रम् उपश्Rण्वति लक्ष्मणे ॥२-२०-३५॥
transliteration: sā rāghavam upāsīnam asukha ārtā sukha ucitā ।uvāca puruṣa vyāghram upaśRṇvati lakṣmaṇe ॥2-20-35॥

translations.english: Kausalya who deserved happiness yet was struck down by (this) distress spoke to Rama, the tiger among men who was sitting nearby, while Lakshmana was listening.
